# Draftly

> Draftly (https://www.draftly.blog) is an AI blog writer for small businesses and agencies. Paste a website URL and Draftly learns the brand's voice, suggests topics from industry news, writes SEO-ready posts with a 0 to 100 human-voice score, and publishes to WordPress, Shopify, Ghost, Webflow, HubSpot and Squarespace. A Preston Vawdrey SEO product.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://www.draftly.blog/pricing): First post free. Solopreneur $29/month (about 66 posts), Growth $69/month (about 233 posts), Autopilot $100/month (about 333 posts, scheduled publishing). Default model GPT 5.4 Mini; Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the recommended premium model.
- [MCP Connector](https://www.draftly.blog/mcp): Connect Draftly to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor at https://app.draftly.blog/mcp. Ten read-only tools expose brand voice, posts, topic ideas and live SEO data from DataForSEO (keyword data on every paid plan, live Google results and domain data on Growth, keyword gaps and backlinks on Autopilot). Included on every paid plan.
- [App](https://app.draftly.blog): Sign up and write the first post free.

## Research

- [Best AI for Writing (2026 Benchmark)](https://www.draftly.blog/best-ai-for-writing): 14 AI models tested on blog writing and copywriting under the same rules, scored on format compliance, human voice, SEO checks and cost per post.

## Blog

- [Draftly Blog](https://www.draftly.blog/blog): Guides on blogging, SEO and AI writing for small businesses.
